cau_hoi.cau: Ham ODD(Number) co chuc nang chinh la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Lam tron len (ra xa so 0) toi so nguyen LE gan nhat
cau_hoi.B: Lam tron xuong toi so chan gan nhat
cau_hoi.C: Lam tron toi so le gan nhat theo qui tac lam tron thong thuong (0.5 moi len)
cau_hoi.D: Tra ve TRUE neu so la le, FALSE neu chan
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ODD luon lam tron RA XA so 0 den so le ke tiep: ODD(4.6)=5, ODD(2)=3. Khac voi kiem tra chan/le bang ISODD.

cau_hoi.cau: Cu phap dung cua ham ODD la?
cau_hoi.A: =ODD(Number) — chi 1 doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ODD chi nhan 1 doi so. Nhieu nguoi nham voi ROUND/ODD can Num_digits hoac CEILING can Significance.

cau_hoi.A: 5 va -3
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ODD(4)=5 vi 4 khong le nen phai len le tiep theo. ODD(-2.1)=-3 (ra xa 0). Bay: tuong 4 giu nguyen 4.

cau_hoi.cau: Phat bieu nao DUNG ve cap ODD/EVEN?
cau_hoi.A: Ca hai deu lam tron RA XA so 0; ODD den le, EVEN den chan; ODD(0)=0
cau_hoi.C: ODD lam tron xuong, EVEN lam tron len
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Ca hai away-from-zero. Ngoai le duy nhat ODD(0)=0. Vi du ODD(-4.6)=-5, EVEN(-3.1)=-4.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham EVEN(Number) dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Lam tron len (ra xa 0) toi so nguyen CHAN gan nhat
cau_hoi.B: Kiem tra o co chua so chan
cau_hoi.D: Lam tron xuong toi so chan
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: EVEN(53.4)=54 theo vi du dienmayxanh. Khong phai ham kiem tra ma ham lam tron.

cau_hoi.A: =EVEN(53.4) tra ve 54
cau_hoi.C: =EVEN(A2:A10) de lam tron ca vung mot lan
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: EVEN chi 1 doi so bat buoc. Khong co Num_digits nhu ROUND.

cau_hoi.A: 4 va -4
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: EVEN(3)=4 (3 da le nen len chan tiep). EVEN(-3.1)=-4 (ra xa 0 ve phia am). Bay: nghi -3.1 ve -2.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon dong goi theo thung 2 cai (so luong o A1), cong thuc nao dung?
cau_hoi.A: =EVEN(A1)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: EVEN dam bao so thung/doi luon chan va du hang. ROUND co the ra le. MROUND lam tron gan nhat chu khong phai luon len.

cau_hoi.A: Nhan tat ca cac doi so, tra ve tich
cau_hoi.B: Cong tat ca roi nhan voi 2
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: PRODUCT(2,3,4)=24. Khac SUM. Nguon dienmayxanh/jobsgo, CFI.

cau_hoi.cau: Cu phap chuan cua PRODUCT la?
cau_hoi.A: =PRODUCT(Number1,[Number2],...) toi da 255 doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Giong SUM nhung la tich. Loi hay gap: them doi so dieu kien nhu SUMIF.

cau_hoi.cau: A1=2, A2 trong, A3=5. =PRODUCT(A1:A3) va =PRODUCT(A1,A2,A3) khac nhau the nao?
cau_hoi.A: Ca hai =10 vi o trong duoc bo qua trong phep nhan
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: O trong trong vung duoc bo qua (khong phai 0). Chi o chua 0 that moi lam tich =0. Bay: tuong o trong =0.

cau_hoi.A: PRODUCT nhan tat ca roi ra 1 tich; SUMPRODUCT nhan tung cap tuong ung roi cong tong
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du PRODUCT(B2:B5)=B2*B3*B4*B5; SUMPRODUCT(B2:B100,C2:C100)=SUM(Bi*Ci). Hay nham vi ten giong nhau.

cau_hoi.A: Noi 2 hay nhieu chuoi van ban thanh mot chuoi (ban moi thay CONCATENATE)
cau_hoi.B: Noi co dieu kien theo vung
cau_hoi.C: Chen dau phay tu dong giua cac chuoi
cau_hoi.D: Noi va tu dong bo qua o trong
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: CONCAT(A2," ",B2)->Nguyen An. CONCAT khong co doi so phan cach/ignore_empty nhu TEXTJOIN.

cau_hoi.A: =CONCAT(Text1,[Text2],...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dap an B la TEXTJOIN. Loi pho bien: lap doi so phan cach cho CONCAT.

cau_hoi.cau: A2=Nguyen, B2=An. Ket qua =CONCAT(A2,B2) la gi va muon 'Nguyen An' phai lam sao?
cau_hoi.A: 'NguyenAn'; phai them " ": =CONCAT(A2," ",B2) hoac A2&" "&B2
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: CONCAT khong tu chen khoang trang/dau phay. Bay: tuong giong TEXTJOIN tu chen delimiter.

cau_hoi.A: CONCAT la ban moi thay the CONCATENATE, cu phap tuong duong, ho tro ca tham chieu vung
cau_hoi.C: CONCAT khong ho tro vung, CONCATENATE thi co
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Microsoft khuyen dung CONCAT (va TEXTJOIN). CONCAT ho tro range ma ban cu CONCATENATE han che tren mot so ban.

cau_hoi.A: Ngay + gio hien tai, tu cap nhat khi mo/tinh lai file
cau_hoi.B: Chi ngay hien tai khong co gio
cau_hoi.C: Chi gio hien tai khong co ngay
cau_hoi.D: Ngay co dinh luc go cong thuc, khong doi
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: NOW bao gom ca date+time, volatile. TODAY chi ngay.

cau_hoi.A: =NOW() — bat buoc co cap ngoac trong du khong co doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Loi pho bien: quen () hoac truyen doi so. NOW khong nhan doi so.

cau_hoi.cau: =NOW()+7 co y nghia gi? Dinh dang nao can de hien du ngay gio?
cau_hoi.A: Ngay gio sau dung 7 ngay nua; dinh dang Date+Time
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Ngay trong Excel la so serial, +1 = 1 ngay. +7/24 moi la 7 gio. Bay: nham +7 la 7 gio.

cau_hoi.A: NOW volatile cap nhat moi lan tinh; TODAY chi phan ngay; ca hai deu volatile
cau_hoi.D: NOW can doi so ngay thang
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Ca NOW va TODAY deu de cap nhat khi mo file/tinh lai. Khac biet: NOW co thanh phan gio.

cau_hoi.A: Tao gia tri ngay tu nam/thang/ngay rieng le
cau_hoi.D: Chuyen chuoi thanh ngay tu dong theo moi locale
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du DATE(2015,5,20)->20/05/2015. Nguon dienmayxanh/cellphones/jobsgo, CFI.

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung cua DATE la?
cau_hoi.A: =DATE(Year, Month, Day)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Loi kinh dien: dao thu tu theo thoi quen Viet (ngay/thang/nam) dan den sai thang/ngay.

cau_hoi.A: 01/01/2027 (thang tran tu dong chuyen sang nam sau)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: DATE tu dong tran: thang 13 = thang 1 nam sau; ngay 32 cung tran. Bay: tuong bao loi.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon tinh so ngay lam viec tu 01/03/2026 den 10/03/2026 nen dung cap nao?
cau_hoi.A: =NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2026,3,1),DATE(2026,3,10))
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: DATE tao serial sach se, tranh loi chuoi-ngay phu thuoc locale. NETWORKDAYS can 2 moc.

cau_hoi.A: Gia tri gio (phan so cua ngay) tu gio/phut/giay rieng le
cau_hoi.C: Chuoi text gio khong tinh toan duoc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du TIME(14,30,0)=14:30. Ban chat la 0.604... ngay.

cau_hoi.A: =TIME(Hour, Minute, Second)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: TIME bat buoc 3 doi so. Thieu giay la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.cau: =TIME(25,0,0) hien thi gi neu dinh dang h:mm?
cau_hoi.A: 1:00 (25h tran sang 1h sang hom sau, gia tri 1.0416...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: TIME tran gio/phut/giay nhu DATE. 25h = 1 ngay +1h. Bay: tuong bao loi gio >24.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon lay gio hien tai (khong lay ngay) tu NOW nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =NOW()-TODAY() hoac =MOD(NOW(),1) roi dinh dang Time
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: TIME can 3 so, khong tach gio tu NOW. Lay phan le cua serial moi dung. Bay: TIME(NOW()) sai cu phap.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham CHOOSE(Index_num, Value1, Value2,...) lam gi?
cau_hoi.A: Chon 1 gia tri tu danh sach theo so thu tu
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du CHOOSE(2,"Thap","Trung binh","Cao")->Trung binh. Nguon cellphones.

cau_hoi.A: =CHOOSE(A2,"Thap","Trung binh","Cao") voi A2=2
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Index phai dung dau tien va la so 1..n. Dao thu tu la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.A: Ca hai #VALUE! vi index ngoai khoang 1..3
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: CHOOSE 1-based, khong co index 0, vuot qua so luong cung loi. Bay: tuong index 0 lay cuoi.

cau_hoi.cau: De xep loai A2 (1=Yeu..5=Xuat sac) gon hon IF long nhau nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =CHOOSE(A2,"Yeu","TB","Kha","Gioi","XS")
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: CHOOSE sang hon IF long 5 cap khi index la so thu tu lien tuc. Bay: dung IF dan den sai ngoac.

cau_hoi.cau: Uu diem lon nhat cua XLOOKUP so voi VLOOKUP la?
cau_hoi.A: Do linh hoat moi huong (lay duoc cot TRAI cot do), khop chinh xac mac dinh, khong can so thu tu cot
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: XLOOKUP(A2,A2:A100,C2:C100,"Not found") — MS khuyen thay VLOOKUP. Nguon CFI/cellphones.

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =XLOOKUP(Lookup_value, Lookup_array, Return_array, [If_not_found],...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Loi VLOOKUP cu: nham sang Col_index_num. XLOOKUP dung 2 vung rieng Lookup/Return.

cau_hoi.A: Khop chinh xac mac dinh, khong tim thay bao #N/A (neu khong co If_not_found)
cau_hoi.B: Tu dong gan dung nhu VLOOKUP thieu FALSE
cau_hoi.C: Bat buoc cot do dau tien cua sheet
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: VLOOKUP quen FALSE/0 se ra gan dung sai. XLOOKUP mac dinh exact match — bay nguoc.

cau_hoi.cau: De hien 'Not found' khi khong thay, viet the nao?
cau_hoi.A: =XLOOKUP(A2,A2:A100,C2:C100,"Not found")
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Doi so thu 4 cua XLOOKUP la If_not_found, gon hon boc IFERROR. Hay dat nham vi tri.

cau_hoi.cau: Bang A=cot Ten, C=cot Ma (Ma o phai Ten). Tim Ma tu Ten dung ham nao?
cau_hoi.A: =XLOOKUP(Ten, A:A, C:C) — XLOOKUP lay duoc phai; VLOOKUP van duoc vi cot lay o phai
cau_hoi.B: Bat buoc INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP khong lam duoc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay that su: lay cot PHAI thi VLOOKUP van duoc; lay cot TRAI moi can XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH. Nhieu nguoi tuyen bo VLOOKUP hoan toan sai.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham TEXTJOIN khac CONCAT o diem nao?
cau_hoi.A: Co ky tu phan cach (Delimiter) va tuy chon bo qua o trong (Ignore_empty)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,A2:A4) voi Tao/Cam/Chuoi. Nguon cellphones.

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =TEXTJOIN(Delimiter, Ignore_empty, Text1,...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Loi pho bien: dao Delimiter/Ignoe_empty xuong sau hoac quen Ignore_empty.

cau_hoi.cau: A2=Tao, A3 trong, A4=Chuoi. =TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,A2:A4) vs FALSE khac nhau?
cau_hoi.A: TRUE->'Tao, Chuoi'; FALSE->'Tao, , Chuoi' (giu cho trong tao 2 phay lien)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay kinh dien: nham TRUE giu cho trong. TRUE moi la bo qua.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi nao bat buoc dung TEXTJOIN thay CONCAT?
cau_hoi.A: Khi can chen dau phay/khoang cach giua cac muc va bo qua o trong linh hoat
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: CONCAT phai chen thu cong " " tung cho va khong bo o trong; TEXTJOIN 1 delimiter ap cho ca vung.

cau_hoi.A: Phan le nam giua 2 ngay, dung tinh lai/phan bo
Chon qui uoc dem ngay (0-4, vd 30/360, actual/actual)
cau_hoi.B: Chon don vi tra ve Y/M/D
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhama voi DATEDIF unit Y/M/D. YEARFRAC dung Basis tai chinh.

cau_hoi.A: YEARFRAC tra phan le (0.25); DATEDIF Y chi tra so nam tron (0)
cau_hoi.C: DATEDIF tra le, YEARFRAC tra tron
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: dung DATEDIF Y de tinh lai phan bo se mat 3 thang le. Tai chinh phai dung YEARFRAC.

cau_hoi.A: Trung vi — gia tri giua sau khi sap xep
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguon CFI/W3Schools. MEDIAN(B2:B100).

cau_hoi.A: 4 (trung binh 2 so giua 3 va 5 sau sap xep 1,3,5,9)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: So luong chan: lay TB 2 so giua. Bay: lay so giua chua sap xep (9) hoac lay AVERAGE=4.5.

cau_hoi.cau: Luong 5,6,7,100tr. AVERAGE=29.5, MEDIAN=6.5. Nen dung so nao mo ta 'luong dien hinh'?
cau_hoi.A: MEDIAN 6.5 vi khong bi keo boi outlier 100
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: cu dung AVERAGE se phong dai. MEDIAN robust voi lech ngoai le.

cau_hoi.A: Lam tron XUONG (ve phia 0) toi N chu so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du ROUNDDOWN(B2,2). Nguon CFI.
Bay: nham voi ROUND (3.15). ROUNDDOWN cat bo phan thua.

cau_hoi.A: -3.14 (ve phia 0, tri tuyet doi giam)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: nghi tron xuong am la -3.15 (xa 0 hon). Dinh nghia Excel: DOWN = ve 0.

cau_hoi.A: Lam tron LEN (ra xa 0) toi N chu so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ROUNDUP(B2,2). Nguon CFI.
Du thua 0.001 cung len 3.15. Bay: nham ROUND (3.14).
Doi xung voi ROUNDDOWN: UP = xa 0. Bay nguoc cap DOWN/UP voi so am.

cau_hoi.A: Gia tri tuyet doi
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ABS(-5)=5. Nguon CFI.

cau_hoi.A: =ABS(Number) — 1 doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhama voi ROUND can 2 doi so.

cau_hoi.cau: Tinh chenh lech tuyet doi giua A2 va B2 dung?
cau_hoi.A: =ABS(A2-B2)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: ABS chi nhan 1 doi so la hieu so. ABS(A)+ABS(B) sai khi cung dau, vi du A=5,B=3: |5-3|=2 nhung |5|+|3|=8. Bay dien hinh.

cau_hoi.A: Hang so pi chinh xac 15 chu so (~3.14159...)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguon MS. Khong doi so nhung bat buoc ().

cau_hoi.A: =PI()
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Quen () se bi hieu la ten vung #NAME?.

cau_hoi.cau: Tinh dien tich hinh tron ban kinh o A1 dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: PI() khong nhan doi so ban kinh. Bay: PI(A1) hoac quen ().

cau_hoi.A: Gia tri hien tai rong theo lai suat chiet khau
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguon CFI/W3Schools. NPV(0.1,B2:B6).

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =NPV(Rate, Value1,[Value2],...) — rate dung truoc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dao rate ra sau la loi pho bien; XNPV moi co dates.

cau_hoi.chu_de: Bay NPV dau tu ban dau
cau_hoi.cau: Von dau tu 1000 o B1 (thoi diem 0), dong tien nam 1-3 o B2:B4, rate 10%. Cong thuc NPV dung?
cau_hoi.A: =-B1+NPV(10%,B2:B4) (von ban dau ngoai NPV vi NPV mac dinh cuoi ky)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay nghiem trong nhat: gom von t0 vao NPV se chiet khau thua 1 ky. Phai cong rieng.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi nao dung XNPV thay NPV?
cau_hoi.A: Khi dong tien khong deu ky, can ngay cu the (Rate, Values, Dates)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: XNPV(0.1,B2:B6,A2:A6). NPV gia dinh cach deu cuoi ky.

cau_hoi.A: Suat sinh loi noi bo — lai suat de NPV=0
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: IRR(B2:B6). Nguon CFI.

cau_hoi.cau: Yeu cau du lieu cua IRR la?
cau_hoi.A: Vung dong tien phai co it nhat 1 so am va 1 so duong (thuong dau tu am dau tien)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Toan duong -> IRR loi #NUM!. Bay: quen von am ban dau.

cau_hoi.cau: Dong tien cach nhau khong deu ngay nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =XIRR(Values, Dates,[Guess])
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: IRR gia dinh deu ky; le ngay phai XIRR ke dates.

cau_hoi.A: Gia tri tuong lai voi gop deu + lai co dinh

cau_hoi.cau: Gui 200/thang, lai 5%/nam, 60 thang. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Loi: quen chia 12 va dao thu tu rate/nper. Dau am cho dong tien ra.

cau_hoi.cau: Tai sao FV ra so am/duong gay nham?
cau_hoi.A: Do qui uoc dau: tien gui ra la am -> FV duong neu pv/pmt am; muon hien duong thi dung pmt am
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: doi dau pmt/pv se dao dau ket qua; phai hieu cash outflow/inflow.

cau_hoi.A: Gia tri hien tai cua khoan dau tu/tra gop

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu 3 doi so dau cua PV la?
cau_hoi.A: Rate, Nper, Pmt
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dao rate/nper/pmt la loi pho bien giong FV/PMT.

cau_hoi.A: PV cho dong tien deu nhau moi ky; NPV cho dong tien khong deu
cau_hoi.C: NPV cho dong deu, PV cho khong deu
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: dung PV cho dong tien du an lech nhau se sai; phai NPV/XNPV.

cau_hoi.A: Tong tien (goc+lai) phai tra moi ky

cau_hoi.cau: Vay 10000, lai 5%/nam, 60 thang. Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.A: =PMT(0.05/12,60,10000) (ra so am the hien tien tra)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Quen chia 12 va dao thu tu nhu FV/PV.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon tach thang 1 thanh lai va goc dung cap nao?
cau_hoi.A: =IPMT(0.05/12,1,60,10000) cho lai; =PPMT(...) cho goc; PMT=IPMT+PPMT
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: tuong PMT la lai. Thuc te PMT tong, IPMT/PPMT tach.

cau_hoi.cau: Ham XOR(Logical1,...) tra ve TRUE khi nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khi so menh de TRUE la LE
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: XOR(TRUE,FALSE)->TRUE; XOR(TRUE,TRUE)->FALSE. Nguon CFI.

cau_hoi.A: FALSE (2 TRUE la chan)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhama voi OR (co TRUE la TRUE). XOR dem chan/le.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon kiem tra 'chi dung 1 trong 2 dieu kien' nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =XOR(A,B) — OR cho TRUE ca khi ca hai dung nen sai
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: dung OR se nhan ca truong hop ca hai dung. XOR moi loai tru.

cau_hoi.A: Dao TRUE<->FALSE
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: NOT(TRUE)->FALSE. Nguon CFI.

cau_hoi.A: =NOT(Logical) — chi 1 doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Truyen 2 dieu kien nhu AND/OR la sai; muon phu dinh nhieu phai boc AND/OR trong NOT.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon kiem tra 'khong phai ca A1>50 va B1>25 deu dung' viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: NOT chi 1 doi so nen phai boc AND. Bay: NOT 2 doi so bao loi.

cau_hoi.A: Neu bieu thuc loi thi hien ket qua thay the, khong loi hien gia tri goc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bat #N/A,#DIV/0!,#VALUE!,#REF!,#NAME?,#NUM!. Nguon CFI/W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: De hien 'Not found' khi VLOOKUP that bai viet?
cau_hoi.A: =IFERROR(VLOOKUP(H3,B2:E21,4,FALSE),"Not found")
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dao doi so hoac thieu doi 2 la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.cau: Rui ro lon nhat khi lam dung =IFERROR(C2/B2,"No battles") khap noi la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Che ca loi logic nghiem trong (#REF!,#NAME?) khien kho debug; nen dung IFNA neu chi so #N/A
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: boc IFERROR mu quan se giau loi tham chieu/sai ten. IFNA chi bat #N/A an toan hon.

cau_hoi.cau: Khi chi muon xu ly khong tim thay cua XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =IFNA(XLOOKUP(...),"Not found") de khong giau loi khac; IFERROR bat tat ca
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: dung IFERROR dai tra se an ca #REF! do xoa cot. IFNA chinh xac hon.

cau_hoi.A: Dich tham chieu N hang/cot tu o goc de tra ve vung/gia tri dong
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du OFFSET(A2,1,2)->C3. Nguon CFI (video chi dung OFFSET dropdown dong).

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =OFFSET(Reference, Rows, Cols, [Height], [Width])
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dao Rows/Cols hoac dat Height truoc la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.A: C3 (len 1, trai 1)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dau am la nguoc huong. Bay: nghi am van tien xuong/phai.

cau_hoi.cau: Han che lon nhat cua OFFSET trong file lon la gi?
cau_hoi.A: La ham volatile — tinh lai moi lan thay doi, gay cham; nen thay bang INDEX/XLOOKUP hien dai
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay hieu nang: lam dung OFFSET khap file se i ach. INDEX khong volatile.

cau_hoi.A: Gom cung o B5 tren moi sheet kep giua Sheet2 va Sheet13
cau_hoi.C: Tong Sheet2 den Sheet13 cua cot B
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguon MS. Kep giua 2 sheet dau-cuoi.

cau_hoi.A: =SUM(Sheet2:Sheet13!B5)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dau : nam giua ten sheet, ! truoc o. Dao vi tri la sai.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen them Sheet7b giua Sheet2 va Sheet13 thi cong thuc 3D se?
cau_hoi.A: Tu dong gom ca sheet moi; keo sheet ra ngoai vung 3D se loai khoi tong
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: tuong 3D co dinh danh sach. Thuc te theo vi tri kep dau-cuoi.

cau_hoi.cau: Kieu tham chieu R1C1 la gi?
cau_hoi.A: Danh so ca hang+cot (R=row,C=column), dung trong macro; bat/tat File>Options>Formulas>R1C1
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nguon MS.

cau_hoi.cau: R[2]C[2] (tu o hien tai) co nghia?
cau_hoi.A: Duoi 2 hang, phai 2 cot (tuong doi)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Ngoac [] la tuong doi; khong ngoac la tuyet doi R2C2.

cau_hoi.A: R2C2 tuyet doi (hang2 cot2=B2); R[2]C[2] tuong doi so voi o chua cong thuc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: nham [] chi de trang tri. Khong ngoac = tuyet doi.

cau_hoi.A: Trung binh cua vung theo 1 dieu kien
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du AVERAGEIF(B2:B10,E3,C2:C10). Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: Tinh TB Speed cua Type Grass (B=Type,C=Speed). Cong thuc dung?
cau_hoi.A: =AVERAGEIF(B2:B10,"Grass",C2:C10)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Dao vung dieu kien/vung tinh la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.A: Criteria chu/so sanh phai trong nhay kep; tham chieu o thi noi chuoi: ">"&E3
cau_hoi.B: Excel tu hieu khong can nhay
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay cu phap: quen nhay cho >50. Voi o dieu kien phai ">"&E3.

cau_hoi.A: Tinh TB theo NHIEU dieu kien AND
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: AVERAGEIFS(C2:C13,B2:B13,"Grass",D2:D13,1). Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: Thu tu doi so dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =AVERAGEIFS(Average_range, Criteria_range1, Criteria1,...) — vung TB dung DAU
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay nang nhat: AVERAGEIF de Range truoc, AVERAGEIFS de Average_range truoc — nguoc nhau!

cau_hoi.cau: TB Defense (C) cua Grass (B) gen1 (D): viet the nao?
cau_hoi.A: =AVERAGEIFS(C2:C13,B2:B13,"Grass",D2:D13,1)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Sai A la dao vung TB thanh vung dieu kien.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon TB Defense cua (Grass HOAC Fire) nen dung AVERAGEIFS truc tiep?
cau_hoi.A: Khong — AVERAGEIFS chi AND; muon OR phai (AVERAGEIF Grass + AVERAGEIF Fire) hoac FILTER roi AVERAGE
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay logic: tuong nhieu criteria la OR. Thuc te AND; OR phai tach.

cau_hoi.A: Tra gia tri cua DIEU KIEN DUNG DAU TIEN, nhieu DK dung lay DK dau
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du IFS(C2>90,"Fast",C2>50,"Normal",C2<=50,"Slow"). Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: Cap doi so cua IFS la?
cau_hoi.A: Tung cap Logical_test, Value_if_true lap lai; le doi so se loi
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Le doi so (thieu value) la loi pho bien.

cau_hoi.A: #N/A vi khong DK nao dung; can them TRUE,"Slow" cuoi de mac dinh
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: tuong tu FALSE nhu IF. IFS khong co nh salam nh mac dinh — phai tu them TRUE.

cau_hoi.A: So xuat hien NHIEU NHAT (1 so)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du MODE.SNGL(B2:E7)->1 (7 lan). Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: Ten ham MODE hien dai dung la?
cau_hoi.A: =MODE.SNGL(...) (ban moi; MODE cu de tuong thich)
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhama voi MOD (chia du). MODE cu van chay nhung nen SNGL.

cau_hoi.cau: Day 1,2,3,4 khong lap lai. =MODE.SNGL(...) tra ve?
cau_hoi.A: #N/A vi khong co so lap
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: tuong tra so dau. Khong lap -> khong co mode -> #N/A.

cau_hoi.A: So o TRONG trong vung, huu ich tim thieu du lieu
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du COUNTBLANK(C2:C21)=8 o trong Type2. Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTBLANK(Range) — 1 vung
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Them Criteria nhu COUNTIF la sai.

cau_hoi.cau: O chua ="" (chuoi rong tu cong thuc) co bi COUNTBLANK dem?
cau_hoi.A: CO — COUNTBLANK dem ca "" du nhin nhu trong; muon loai phai dung FILTER/LEN
cau_hoi.C: Chi dem that trong vat ly
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay kiem soat chat luong: tuong "" la khong trong. Excel van dem.

cau_hoi.A: Tra ve cac dong thoa DK dang mang dong
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Vi du FILTER(A2:E21,C2:C21="Fire"). Nguon W3Schools.

cau_hoi.cau: Loc Bug VA >300 viet the nao?
cau_hoi.A: =FILTER(A2:E21,(C2:C21="Bug")*(E2:E21>300)) — AND dung *, OR dung +
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhan * la AND, cong + la OR trong mang boolean. Dung AND() boc ngoai se vo tac dung mang dong.

cau_hoi.cau: =FILTER(A2:E21,C2:C21="Rong") khong co dong nao va khong co If_empty thi?
cau_hoi.A: #CALC! (trong); nen them doi 3: FILTER(...,"Khong co")
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay: tuong ra #N/A nhu lookup. Dynamic array trong ra #CALC!.

cau_hoi.cau: De dem so Bug co Total>300 sau khi loc nen dung?
cau_hoi.A: =ROWS(FILTER(A2:E21,(C2:C21="Bug")*(E2:E21>300))) hoac COUNTIFS goc
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay cu phap long nhau: FILTER tra mang, can ROWS/COUNTA boc ngoai.

cau_hoi.A: Tong BINH PHUONG cac doi so
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: SUMSQ(B2:B5)=B2^2+... Nguon CFI.
Bay nang: nham voi (SUM)^2 =25. SUMSQ cong binh phuong truoc.

cau_hoi.A: SUMSQ cong cac binh phuong; PRODUCT nhan truc tiep; khong thay the nhau
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Nhama vi deu la toan hang luy thua/nhan.

cau_hoi.chu_de: Bay phan cach nhieu ky tu
cau_hoi.A: Tao, Cam, Chuoi
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Delimiter la ', ' (phay+cach) lap giua moi muc; nham CONCAT khong phay.

cau_hoi.cau: Tim tu phai sang trai (Return o TRAI Lookup) phai lam sao? XLOOKUP co can match_mode dac biet?
cau_hoi.A: Khong can — XLOOKUP mac dinh tim chinh xac moi huong; chi can Lookup_array va Return_array dung vi tri; VLOOKUP thi bat buoc INDEX/MATCH
cau_hoi.giai_thich_chi_tiet: Bay tong hop: nham XLOOKUP cung gioi han huong nhu VLOOKUP. Match_mode chi cho wildcard/khop gan dung, search_mode moi dieu khien thu tu tim.
